process_lessons.lesson: Follow semantic ownership before proposing implementation; research analogues can rediscover promoted mechanisms.
Use the strongest already-rehabilitated control; raw G04 would double-count obsolete publication cost.

Repeated red performance gates on unchanged product code can be infrastructure evidence rather than product causality; preserve failures but stop retry loops after classification is decision-complete.
A hot helper can be causally real yet strategically too small; scalar varint dispatch and Logs full-pack proof reuse were measurable but low-yield.

Before optimizing arithmetic inside reconstruction, test whether multiple integrity layers prove the same successful full-operation fact; proof ownership can dominate micro-optimization while preserving stronger terminal verification.
